validity.researcher_notes: Independently re-measured the routes-repo GeoJSON for P4146 (Nadym-Punga line III) via haversine summation over its 114-point LineString: total mapped length ≈ 50.4 km, against the sheet's recorded LengthKnown=566.0 km -- the digitized geometry covers only ≈8.9% of the pipeline's claimed length. The line's geographic extent (lat 62.80–62.98°N, lon 64.34–65.13°E) is a small interior fragment; it does not reach the Nadym origin area (≈65.53°N, 72.52°E), consistent with this being a short interior segment of the corridor rather than an end-to-end trace of the full pipeline. This matches the task brief's own pre-existing annotation for this PID ('OK_INTERIOR' -- not flagged as a direction/endpoint mismatch, but as an incomplete-coverage geometry). RouteAccuracy=high implies confident, essentially complete tracing; a route covering roughly a tenth of the claimed length does not support that rating regardless of how accurately the traced portion itself is digitized. Per controlled_vocab.md, 'high' is not blocked by the unbuilt-cap rule for this operating row -- the cap only applies to proposed/shelved/cancelled/construction rows -- so this is a substantive, evidence-based contest of the value, not a vocabulary-rule violation. NOTE: OpenStreetMap tags/geometry are read here only for internal validity judgment, per standing rules -- not cited as a [ref] or corroboration source anywhere in this shard's fills.
